First, I'll check the statement part by part.  

1. **"call sign w230av has a city of license of anniston , alabama"**  
   From the table, w230av has city of license "gadsden , alabama", not "anniston , alabama". So this part is false.

2. **"call sign w269x has a city of license of griffin , georgia"**  
   The table has w269ax, not w269x. Also, w269ax has city of license "anniston , alabama".  
   Even if we ignore the missing 'a' in the call sign, the city doesn't match "griffin , georgia".  
   Griffin, Georgia is listed for w290ag.

Since both parts are false, the whole statement is false.

Final Answer: No
